usageNotes: Use this to detach or permanently delete one or more disk images from a VM's configuration. Without `force`, disks are moved to `unused[n]` entries rather than deleted — use this safer default when you may need to recover the volume later. To permanently destroy the underlying storage volume, either set `force: true` or run unlink a second time targeting the resulting `unused[n]` entry. The VM does not need to be stopped, but the disk must not be in active use (e.g., avoid unlinking the boot disk while the VM is running).

examples.summary: Detach scsi1 from VM 105 without deleting the volume (moves to unused)

tips: Omitting `force` is the safe default — the volume remains on storage as `unused[n]` and can be reattached or deleted later.
To permanently remove the volume in one step, set `force: true`.
Unlinking an `unused[n]` entry (e.g., `unused0`) always performs physical removal regardless of the `force` flag.
`idlist` accepts a comma-separated list (e.g., `scsi1,scsi2`) to unlink multiple disks in a single call.
This operation returns null synchronously — there is no UPID; the change is applied immediately to the VM config.
